title: Population by place of residence and sex divided into urban and rural areas (as of 31 Dec; total, urban areas, rural areas; national and gmina level)
publisher: GUS (Statistics Poland) - Bank Danych Lokalnych API v1
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P1336; variables 60641 (total), 60617 (urban), 60633 (rural); unit-level 0 (country) and 6 (gminas)
notes: Place of residence, as of 31 December, both sexes. Series 2020+ recalculated by GUS on the 2021 census. 2025 is the latest year available on the access date.

title: World Bank indicator SP.URB.TOTL - Urban population (Poland)
publisher: World Bank (based on UN World Urbanization Prospects)
notes: Cross-check only. Different definitions and methodology from GUS; never used for class figures.

title: World Bank indicator SP.POP.TOTL - Population total (Poland)
notes: Cross-check only; mid-year concept and revisions differ from GUS 31 Dec figures.

title: World Bank indicator SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS - Urban population (% of total population) (Poland)
publisher: World Bank (based on UN World Urbanization Prospects)
notes: Cross-check only.

title: BDL API documentation (unit levels and unit id structure)
notes: Documents unit levels (0 country ... 6 gmina). The meaning of the last digit of the 12-character unit id (1 urban, 2 rural, 3 urban-rural, 4 urban part, 5 rural part) is as described in the task brief and consistent with the data (sum of type 1-3 gminas equals the national total 2002-2025); verified empirically here.

title: Gnat, 2024: suburbanisation in large and medium-sized Polish cities (2011 and 2021 censuses)
notes: Interpretation only (suburbanisation as a driver of village growth). Found via web search; only the abstract-level claim was used. Full text not reviewed.

title: Badach and Cymanow, 2019: migration to suburban municipalities of four agglomerations
publisher: Annals of the Polish Association of Agricultural and Agribusiness Economists
notes: Interpretation only (dominant migration flow into suburban municipalities). Found via web search; only the abstract-level claim was used.

title: Population by sex and age group (5-year groups; national, 31 Dec)
notes: Place of residence. From 2010 the open interval is split (70-74 ... 85+); 2000 has only 70 and more. Series 2020+ recalculated on the 2021 census.

title: Demographic dependency ratio, ageing ratio
notes: Ratios from 2002/2003 only; working age = women 15-59, men 15-64 (GUS definition, differs from the Eurostat 15-64 convention).

title: Population at pre-working, working and post-working age, urban and rural areas
notes: Urban/rural only from 2012. Working age follows the GUS definition in force each year.

title: Median age of population by sex (total, urban, rural)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P3814 (national, from 2018) and P3813 (urban/rural, from 2016)
notes: Median age before 2016 is not in BDL; the Eurostat series S19 is used for 2000-2015 (reference date differs, see its notes).

title: Live births, deaths, natural increase, infant deaths (national; urban and rural)
notes: P3992 gives the urban/rural split from 2000. Per 1000 population values are as published by GUS.

title: Total fertility rate (BDL 'fertility') and gross reproduction rate
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P2346 (59049 fertility, 59048 gross reproduction)
notes: Series start in 2002. Lowest published level is voivodeship, so no urban/rural or place-class split. BDL labels the variable only 'fertility'; the values (1.249 in 2002, 1.068 in 2025) match the total fertility rate of Eurostat S21.

title: Life expectancy at birth by sex (total, urban, rural)
notes: Years of life. 2020+ values are affected by COVID-19 excess mortality.

title: Migration for permanent residence: internal and international (national and gmina level)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P1350 (national: 1365224, 80121-80124, 1365229, 1365234, 80125, 80108; gmina level: net internal 80125, net abroad 80108)
notes: Based on registrations of permanent residence (meldunki). It records only changes of registered permanent residence, so it under-counts short-term and unregistered moves, and it misses most post-2022 Ukrainian refugees (who held temporary protection).

title: Households and population in households, National Census 2002
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P2115 (9199 total households) and P2871 (194829-194840 by size)
notes: Census 2002 household concept (housekeeping units). National total.

title: Households by number of persons, National Census 2011
notes: Census 2011. Sample-based components are published with precision indices; only the numerical data variables are used.

title: Households by number of persons, National Census 2021 (national and gmina level)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P4287 (1652549-1652556); gmina level for 1652549 and 1652555
notes: Census 2021 (state of 31 March 2021). The 2021 household total (12.5 million) is lower than 2011 (13.6 million) while the average size is higher (2.99 vs 2.82); BDL gives no concept note, so the 2002/2011/2021 household counts are not assumed to be strictly comparable.

title: Eurostat demo_pjanind: population structure indicators (median age, dependency ratios), Poland
notes: Reference date 1 January of the year (GUS BDL: 31 December of the previous year). Dependency ratios use 15-64 as working age.

title: Eurostat demo_gind: population change, births, deaths, net migration plus adjustment, Poland
notes: Net migration plus statistical adjustment is a residual (population change minus natural change), not a count of movers.

title: Eurostat demo_find: total fertility rate, Poland
notes: Provides 2000-2001, which BDL (S13) lacks. Eurostat flags (b = break, e = estimate, p = provisional) are in data/raw/eurostat_poland.csv.

title: Eurostat migr_imm1ctz / migr_emi1ctz: immigration and emigration by citizenship, Poland
indicator_or_table_code: migr_imm1ctz, migr_emi1ctz (age TOTAL, sex T, agedef COMPLET)
notes: Poland's series has a large level break between 2008 (about 15 thousand) and 2009 (about 189 thousand) because of a change in the reporting basis (reasons not verified in a GUS note). The Ukrainian-citizen series has only two observations in Eurostat, so it is not used.

title: Eurostat migr_asytpsm: beneficiaries of temporary protection at end of month, Ukrainian citizens in Poland
notes: Stock of people holding EU temporary protection status, not net migration and not all Ukrainians in Poland (excludes pre-2022 residents, workers and students on other titles).

title: Eurostat lfst_hhantych: persons per private household (EU Labour Force Survey), Poland
indicator_or_table_code: lfst_hhantych (phhcomp TOTAL, agechild TOTAL, n_child TOTAL)
notes: Annual survey estimate, 2006 onward. Survey-based and not directly comparable with census household counts (S16-S18).

title: Demographic situation in Poland up to 2024 (GUS publication page)
notes: Listed as the authoritative narrative source. Only the existence and title of the publication were confirmed here; no figure in this series is taken from it.

title: Gmina polygons (PRG) used for gmina centroids
publisher: Poland-geography task in this repository (GUGiK PRG, simplified)
notes: Local file built in task #13 from the official PRG boundaries; used only to find the gmina centre point for distance to the 8 largest cities. Centroids are of simplified outlines. Repository file URL.

title: Ukrainian refugees in Poland - number and distribution
publisher: Journal of Geography, Politics and Society (University of Gdansk)
notes: Interpretation only (scale of the 2022 inflow and its location). Found via web search; only the search-result summary was read, not the full text.

title: Raźniak, 2014: migration in Wielka Wieś municipality as an expression of suburbanisation of the Kraków suburban zone
publisher: Repository of the Academy of Physical Education in Krakow (UAFM)
notes: Interpretation only (inflow from the core city dominates and villages bordering the city are most attractive). Found via web search; only the abstract-level claim was used. Author surname appears as 'Raźniak' in the source.

title: Dwellings completed: number, rooms and useful floor area, total and by form of construction (national, gmina level; 1995-2025)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P3824 (748601 total dwellings, 748603 floor area, 748604 private = own use of the investor from 2005, 748607/748610/748616/748619/748622 other forms)
notes: Own-use 'private' is 0 with attribute x before 2005. Variable level is shown as 7 in the API but gmina-level (6) data exist.

title: Dwellings completed by forms of construction (to 2017)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P1735 (415 total, 430 private = individual construction, 432 private floor area, 2250 for sale or rent, 418 cooperative, 424 municipal, 1554 TBS, 421 company, 411017/411018 private own use / for sale 2013-2017)
notes: Series ends 2017; continued by P3824 (S41) with a changed split of 'private'.

title: Dwellings completed (quarterly data), January-December cumulative: dwellings and floor area in single-family, multi-family, non-residential, expanded and converted buildings (gmina level, 2009-2025)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P3821 (748241 total, 748244 new residential, 748247 single-family dwellings, 748250 multi-family dwellings, 748249/748252 floor area, 748253 non-residential, 748256 expansion, 748259 reconstruction)
notes: The only gmina-level direct houses-vs-flats series for completions; starts in 2009.

title: Dwelling stocks (number, floor area, urban/rural) and average floor area (gmina level, 1995-2025)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P2166 (60811 dwellings, 60813 floor area, 60807/60812 urban/rural) and P2430 (60572 average floor area, 60573 per person, 410600 per 1000 population)
notes: Annual stock balance as of 31 December.

title: Dwellings in permits granted and registrations with a construction project, by type of building (quarterly data, January-December cumulative; gmina level, 2009-2025)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subject P4216 (1641096 total dwellings, 1641098 single-family, 1641099 two-dwelling, 1641100 three-or-more dwelling buildings)
notes: Dated by the year of the permit, not of completion.

title: Dwellings: permits granted, construction started and completed (powiat and national level; 2005-2017 and 2016-2019)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P2956 (217329 permits total, 217340 starts total, 217389 starts private; 2005-2017) and P3747 (567225 permits, 567218 starts total, 567219 starts private; 2016-2019)
notes: Annual starts exist only to powiat level and end in 2019; no later annual series was found.

title: New buildings completed by number of dwellings (definitions valid to 2017; 2017 under the 2018 definitions)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P2479 (377356 one-dwelling, 377350 two-dwelling, 377348 three-and-more buildings; 2012-2017) and P3769 (632895/632897/632898, 2017 only)
notes: Counts buildings, not dwellings; used only as a cross-check of S43.

title: Dwellings, National Census 2021 (all, inhabited, uninhabited; gmina level)
indicator_or_table_code: BDL subjects P4207 (1640943 all dwellings, 1640629 inhabited, 1640630 uninhabited) and P4383 (1723485 inhabited dwellings, 1723486 floor area)
notes: Used only to compare with the annual stock balance.

title: Budownictwo mieszkaniowe wciaz na fali (housing construction still riding the wave)
notes: States that GUS changed its publication methodology slightly from January 2018 and moved individually built dwellings that are sold at once into 'for sale or rent'. The GUS methodological note itself was not found; the text is paywalled after this point. Interpretation only, no number comes from it.
